filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("night-time economy" OR "nighttime economy" OR "night-time city" OR "urban night" OR nightlife) NOT ("nighttime light" OR "night-time light" OR "night light"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
